name: plx
description: Parallax (plx) — multi-model coding-agent orchestration. The /plx:auto router dispatches to dev, plan, or review; explicit /plx:* commands force a pipeline or a single engine (codex/grok). dev = plan → build → review → fix → docs, delegated to subagent lanes. Plan and review lanes are read-only; the writer engine is configurable.
